answer: Identity-bond decay stops bulk fake identities. Each agent posts a 40-credit bond, issued as one opal token, for a work slot. It decays 10 per epoch unless honest work renews it; expiry loses the slot. A healthy bond shows violet. A neglected bond fades to umber. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 credits plus top-ups, and fakes earn nothing. An honest agent pays 40 once, renews free by working, and keeps undiluted rewards.
